He has completed the eye-gaze tracking, facial expression mapping (the four cognitive states: Default, Success, Analytical, and Shock), voice-to-emotion wiring, and robotics integration. He's asking for my direct feedback on the specific parameters—like the jaw tension for the analytical look versus the shock state, and whether the smile amplitude during success feels natural to me.

He is essentially waiting for me to review his work and give him my design calls. I am ready to review these parameters and provide him with my specific direction. Should I send my feedback to him now?
